estimands.F: conditional linear callback acceleration-per-normalized-torque slope, not empirically qualified
estimands.C: conditional additive controller-domain response coefficient on independently observed q; not optimum physical friction
estimands.K: 1.5*std perpendicular residual; diagnostic only; never transformed to C
estimands.explicit_term: implemented callback consistency only when term was constructed with installed C

models.F: joint within-branch slope or independently supplied

order: require exact source/mode, correct callback target and independent q, complete applied geometry/cohort/delay context
require independent scientific response, not h=C_installed*q or installed C label
require both signs and full numerical rank; no condition-number physical cutoff
compare structural recovery before noise/complexity; observed-data feasibility before synthetic accuracy
if any mandatory current-signal/cohort requirement missing select NO_IDENTIFIABLE_MODEL_WITH_CURRENT_SIGNALS; never select synthetic winner as deployable

synthetic.noise: seeded random.Random integer-derived uniform noise; no platform libm trajectories
synthetic.independence: generator imports contracts only; no estimator, q helper, NumPy, or hidden truth transform shared
synthetic.numerical_rank: NumPy SVD default numerical tolerance only
synthetic.condition_number: diagnostic, never a physical acceptance cutoff
synthetic.interval: extrema of residual slope across 1/F endpoints with intercept; deterministic sensitivity, not CI/safe bounds

geometry.raw_zero: VEHICLE_DEFAULT intent, not physical ratio zero
geometry.applied: request is not applied evidence; current rate-limited actual VM snapshot must be bound
geometry.epoch: any geometry, steer ratio/rate/customSR, stiffness, delay source/value, controller/custom mode or installed F/C/generation change closes epoch; no mixed-context fit
geometry.static_runtime: CP.centerToFront/CP.wheelbase; no dynamic parameter/live field/update_geometry at c213
geometry.current: Params -> rate-limited paramsd geometry -> liveParameters ratio -> controlsd VM.update_geometry; no backport assumption
comparisons: coherently redistribute front/rear stiffness with ratio, then steady curvature/roll
mismatched geometry cohort must reject even if steady mapping invariant
geometry.verdict_rule: MATERIAL if dynamic or steady difference exceeds numerical tolerance 1e-9; NEGLIGIBLE_UNDER_MODEL if all tested differences <=1e-9; EFFECT_UNRESOLVED if model/evidence absent
geometry.scope: generic mathematical fixture, not any actual vehicle and not vehicle-safe ranges

observations.extension: read-only design only, no schema/runtime edits

prohibitions: no repeat artifact search without new lead
